The house

A place for
time together.

Four bedrooms, a spacious living area and room for the little rituals of a holiday.

VILLA LAUBACH / 01

Come together

Long conversations, a shared meal and time without hurry. The living area is the centre of your days together.

VILLA LAUBACH / 02

Room to rest

Four bedrooms accommodate up to eight guests. Bright windows and individual furnishings give the rooms their character.

VILLA LAUBACH / 03

At your own pace

Start the day your own way in the kitchen. A washing machine is also available.

VILLA LAUBACH / 04

Time in the open air

The terrace and green outdoor spaces offer places to sit and take a breath.

GOOD TO KNOW

Make yourself at home.

Your accommodation in the building

The guest accommodation is a self-contained unit. A separate loft in the same building may sometimes be occupied by the host. There are stairs in the house. Please discuss any specific needs and the use of outdoor areas directly with the host before booking.
